opening.argument: The presentation promotes earnings through a cryptocurrency exchange and links mining activity to substantially increased cryptocurrency returns. The speaker then describes a recruitment structure in which invited miners become partners and states that participants receive ten percent of what their network earns across five generations. He also says those invited users paid no rubles to begin mining, while presenting the arrangement as a way to generate returns through a layered referral network. That combination of exchange earnings, mining claims, and multi-generation commissions establishes the recruitment-based earning structure at the center of the presentation.
